task.title: Managing a Paid Subscription
task.shortdesc: How organization administrators can open the Verifone account page to manage a paid subscription.

prereq.p: You must have the Organization Administrator role in your organization.

context.p: Use this procedure to access the Verifone account page for an active paid subscription.

step.cmd: Click Manage subscription in the subscription status and actions section.
Review the dialog box instructions. The dialog box shows the order reference number and includes a copy button for quick access.
Use the Verifone page to update payment methods, enable or disable auto-renewal, or review billing history.
